description: Validate a manifest.json across browsers. This reports missing fields, invalid permissions, dangling file references, and cross-browser compatibility issues. Read buildBlocking for the errors that make extension_build refuse.

browser.description: Single browser to validate against; alias for browsers:[browser] to match the other tools.

manifestPath.description: Path to manifest.json. Or pass projectPath and the manifest is located for you.

projectPath.description: Path to the extension project root; manifest.json is resolved from it (root or src/). Accepted in place of manifestPath.

name: extension_manifest_validate
